articles.summary: (NYSE: AEM) (TSX: AEM) ("Agnico Eagle" or the "Company") reports that a rock mass movement occurred on July 1, 2026, along the north wall of the Barnat open pit at the Canadian Malartic complex in Quebec, Canada. There were no injuries, equipment damage or environmental impact as a result of the event. As a precautionary measure, the Company has temporarily suspended mining operations in the Barnat open pit.
